t: Founded in 756 by Abd al-Rahman I, a survivor of the Abbasid massacre of the Umayyad family.
It made al-Andalus an independent Islamic state and began the Great Mosque of Córdoba around 785.
After decades of revolt, Abd al-Rahman III reunited it and declared it a caliphate in 929.
dyk: Exiles expelled from Córdoba after the Revolt of the Arrabal of 818 later took part in the conquest of Crete, which became an Arab emirate for over a century.
ev: Abd al-Rahman I defeats Yusuf al-Fihri at al-Musara and becomes emir
Charlemagne’s expedition to Zaragoza fails; rearguard destroyed at Roncesvalles
Construction of the Great Mosque of Córdoba begins
Al-Hakam I crushes the Revolt of the Arrabal in Córdoba
Vikings sack Seville and are defeated at Tablada
Umar ibn Hafsun begins his rebellion from Bobastro
Bobastro falls to Abd al-Rahman III
Abd al-Rahman III proclaims himself caliph
